notes.title: Kickstarter Countdown Sale!
notes.notes:
Hi all, and thank you for taking the time to read this post!

As previously announced, we're currently running a Kickstarter to fund the localization of the upcoming follow-up to Neighbor, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2098570429/help-us-localize-horror-visual-novel-game-carrion/]Carrion Crow[/url]. The Kickstarter is now in its final week! To help promote the campaign, for the next week both Neighbor and the Lingering Memories DLC are [b]20% off[/b]! If you've been holding off, this is the perfect chance to pick up Neighbor, and if the game wets your horror whistle, you'll definitely want to get in early and support Carrion Crow for more independent horror goodness.

We also posted an update on the campaign today featuring a preview demo from the game's soundtrack, composed by Yonao Keishi (known for such games as YU-NO and Dies irae), plus an interview with the man himself, so be sure to give it a look!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2098570429/help-us-localize-horror-visual-novel-game-carrion/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33607509/cb9a035485a4ef7eec9b50ab1c4f713282254fc1.png[/img][/url]
Check out Carrion Crow on Kickstarter!

notes.title: Kickstarter for Neighbor follow-up launched!
notes.notes:
The day is here!

After putting up our campaign preview last week, we've made a few final adjustments, and the Kickstarter for the Neighbor follow-up, Carrion Crow, is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2098570429/338856707?ref=612166&token=52fd62b4]live now[/url]! Please check out the campaign, spread the word, and make whatever contribution you can!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2098570429/338856707?ref=612166&token=52fd62b4][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33607509/cb9a035485a4ef7eec9b50ab1c4f713282254fc1.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2098570429/338856707?ref=612166&token=52fd62b4]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2098570429/338856707?ref=612166&token=52fd62b4[/url]

We have some lofty goals this time, including a stretch goal to expand our soundtrack with contributions from [b]Masuko Tsukasa[/b] ([i]Shin Megami Tensei[/i] series, [i]Caligula[/i]), [b]Murasaki Hirofumi[/b] ([i]Sakura Taisen[/i] series), [b]Satou Gou[/b] ([i]Raiden[/i] series), and [b]Kaida Akari[/b] ([i]Breath of Fire[/i], [i]Resident Evil[/i])! We're looking forward to having all of your support again to help make this happen! If you have any questions about the campaign, don't hesitate to let us know on the comments page or via a message.

Let's make this happen!

notes.title: Kickstarter launching soon for Neighbor follow-up game!
notes.notes:
Hey all! First and foremost, we want to thank everyone who's bought Neighbor on Steam, and especially everyone who's left a review. Your support is invaluable!

We've been teasing this a little bit, and you may already have been aware if you've been following the Japanese side of our social media, but we have a big announcement: a follow-up game to Neighbor is in development, for release in Summer 2019!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2098570429/338856707?ref=612166&token=52fd62b4][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33607509/0d1c33434ebf1b89fd26bce4a0b2069ac279673b.png[/img][/url]
Click on the image to check out the Kickstarter preview now!

What this also means, though, is that we need your help. Localizing a text-heavy game like this is a big task, and we'll be returning to Kickstarter to raise the funds we'll need in order to make it possible, plus make some sweet rewards available that we wouldn't be able to produce otherwise!

The Carrion Crow Kickstarter will launch at [b]7PM PT this Sunday, Nov. 11[/b], and last for one month - but you can take a look at the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2098570429/338856707?ref=612166&token=52fd62b4]preview page[/url] now to get an idea of what we have in store! We're especially keen to meet our stretch goals this time, one of which will allow us to expand the game's music team to include composers from franchises like [i]Resident Evil[/i] and [i]Shin Megami Tensei[/i]! Be sure to check out the Kickstarter preview for all the details, and most of all, [b]please help spread the word[/b]!

We're looking forward to all of your support again to help us continue to be able to bring niche Japanese horror to an international audience!

notes.title: Lingering Memories Side-Story DLC released!
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween!
The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/946520/Neighbor__Lingering_Memories_SideStory/?snr=1_5_9__405]Lingering Memories side-story[/url] DLC expansion for Neighbor has been released on Steam! In Lingering Memories it's up to you to decide how to investigate the mysteries you come across - but will you make it out alive?

To celebrate the release of the DLC, we've also launched two Neighbor bundles on Steam: one with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/9128/Neighbor__Lingering_Memories_DLC/?snr=1_5_9__403]game and side-story[/url], and one with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8621/Neighbor_Deluxe_Edition/?snr=1_5_9__403]all the DLC wrapped up in one[/url]! Both are 10% off, so if you haven't checked out Neighbor yet, this is the perfect chance!

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: 20% Seasonal Edition
notes.notes:
Boo!

Haha, Halloween is so easy. Although I’ve never understood the rules when it falls on a weekday, and like all miserable British whingers I resent its weird expansion from a few hours of hiding from unpleasant infants into an entire sodding month of pumpkins and rubbish horror. So with that in mind, let’s have a spooooky Unknown Pleasures!

Threatening but then being too British to actually ‘trick’ anyone this week: barely interactive fiction, a multiplayer indie with actual players, and a stick on the moon. (more…)

notes.title: Official Guidebook DLC released!
notes.notes:
Hey, Neighbor fans! We hope you've continued to enjoy the game!

Hot on the heels of the Original Soundtrack DLC, we've just released the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/954221/Neighbor__Official_Guidebook/]Official Guidebook[/url] for the game as DLC as well! Chock full of artwork, sketches, and behind-the-scenes info and insight!

We're also currently preparing the [url=https://www.otusunland.com/lingering-memories]Lingering Memories[/url] side-story DLC for release - this expansion for the game adds a new episode exploring an incident mentioned in the main game. Look forward to more info about that very soon!

notes.title: Soundtrack DLC released!
notes.notes:
We hope you've all been enjoying Neighbor!

We've just released the game's soundtrack, created by famous composer Takami Ryu, as DLC for the game. If you enjoyed the game's music, you won't want to miss this!
The Official Guidebook DLC is coming very soon as well, so keep an eye out for that!

We've also pushed an update patch for the Japanese version of the game, which fixes an error related to game crashes (which is not present in the English version).

Neighbor is still 10% off in celebration of the launch for a few more days, so if you haven't picked it up yet, now's the time!
